visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand holds an intricately designed, pink-colored paper cutout with floral and Japanese characters against a backdrop of a clear blue sky and the dark-tiled roof of a traditional Japanese temple. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, highlighting the semi-transparent texture of the pink cutout. (2) The scene shifts to a detailed black dragon sculpture acting as a fountain, with water pouring from its mouth into a stone basin. The basin is filled with vibrant pink and peach-colored floating flowers, with small purple flowers in the background. The camera pans slightly to follow the water flow. (3) A display showcase is presented, featuring multiple colorful, artistic temple stamps or seals (Goshuin) arranged in a grid. Each seal features unique floral patterns like sunflowers, irises, and pine trees. The camera pans downward to show the variety of designs and their corresponding labels. (4) The final phase shows a tall gray stone pillar engraved with Japanese calligraphy standing at the base of stone steps. The steps lead up to the entrance of a temple surrounded by green pine trees under a sunny sky. The shot is a medium full shot establishing the location's entrance.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本尖心瘋 ジャパンナッツ. [Slogan]: 東京最美 櫻花御朱印 就在「法輪寺」. (2) [Slogan]: 這裡原本以「花手水」聞名 後來因為超美的御朱印又爆紅. (3) [Slogan]: 御朱印共有11款 10款花朵樣式+1款年度款 每款價格為日幣1,000. (4) [Slogan]: 「法輪寺」在早稻田站 出站步行2分鐘即達，非常方便.
